Modification: subsetted to 61 glyphs (see manifest.ts in this package) and
renamed to "PolyhymniaNotation" per OFL-FAQ 2.6 (subsetting does not preserve
Functional Equivalence, so the Reserved Font Name may not be retained on the
modified font).
